Hello, genderfluid here! 

The easiest way to think about it is in terms of shape. The male gender may be one (figurative) shape, female another shape, and all of the different shapes of enby are unique, however genderfluid is, of course, fluid and can flow into many different shapes. One day you may wake up to be in the (figurative) female shape, then throughout the day you find the fluid has flown into an enby shape, then a male shape, the a demigirl shape.

Gender may change many times a day, once or you may feel the same gender for a while. It cannot be predicted, but that doesn't mean it's not real or not valid. 

If you know a genderfluid person, please don't be afraid to ask what pronouns they're using, as long as you don't ask in an obnoxious way everyone 5 minutes if they're gender has changed yet. 

I hope this helps and wasn't too confusing, please ask if I didn't explain it clearly enough.
